request.style: English, Christian hip hop, confident male rapper delivering tight rhymed verses, a melodic sung hook by a female vocalist, boom bap drums, deep 808 bass, dark piano loop, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Taken from Jerusalem, dropped in Babylon
New name, new tongue, they want the old me gone
Kings table spread with the richest wine and meat
Daniel made up his mind, that is food I won't eat
Asked the chief official, give us ten days of greens
Water and vegetables, then see what it means
If we look worse than the boys who eat the king's food
Do what you want, but give us ten days to prove

[Chorus]
I'm in Babylon but I'm not of it
They can change my name but they can't change my heart
I won't bow down, I won't be bought
In Babylon, I still belong to God

[Verse]
Ten days later, look at them, they shine
Healthier and stronger than the ones who drank the wine
God gave them knowledge, wisdom, every skill in a book
Daniel understood the visions and the dreams they took
The king put them to the test with every question he had
Ten times better than the magicians in his land
So when the world says blend in, take the easy road
Remember four young men who would not let go

[Chorus]
I'm in Babylon but I'm not of it
They can change my name but they can't change my heart
I won't bow down, I won't be bought
In Babylon, I still belong to God
